definitions.explanation: An area that experiences exceptionally heavy snowfall. In Japan, this is also a legally designated category covering large parts of {東北|とうほく}, {北陸|ほくりく}, and {北海道|ほっかいどう} that receive special government support.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新潟|にいがた}→新潟：27452_niigata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}だ。
examples.english: Niigata is a heavy snowfall region.

examples.japanese: {豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雪|ゆき}{下|お}ろし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: In heavy snowfall regions, clearing snow off the roof is essential.

examples.japanese: {豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{除雪|じょせつ}→除雪：18195_josetsu⟧⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Areas designated as heavy snowfall regions can receive government support for snow removal costs and other expenses.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{豪雪|ごうせつ}→豪雪：18246_gousetsu⟧ (heavy snowfall) + ⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧ (zone/region). Beyond its descriptive meaning, this is an official designation under the 1962 {豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧{措置法|そちほう}, covering more than half of Japan by area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be designated a heavy-snowfall region
- {豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧: life in snow country
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧{豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}: special heavy-snowfall region (most severe designation)
